# Maximum Bridge Span

Maximum unsupported horizontal span between two supported regions.

<figure markdown="span">
![Maximum Bridge Span: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-bridge-span-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Maximum Bridge Span: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-bridge-span-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Horizontal distance spanned without support between two supported regions.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [FDM](../../reference/processes/fdm-3d-printing.md) | High |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At most** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "FDM"

    Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 15 mm | 40 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | PLA | 20 mm | 50 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber) | 18 mm | 45 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | PETG | 12 mm | 35 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | ABS | 10 mm | 30 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | ASA | 10 mm | 30 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | TPU (Flexible) | 8 mm | 20 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | PA | 10 mm | 30 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | PA-CF (Carbon Fiber) | 15 mm | 40 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | PC | 10 mm | 30 mm | Not yet sourced |


=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 21 mm | 29 mm | Aim for: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 2 and 3: 21 mm for a 5 mm wide beam")<br>At most: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 4: 29 mm for a 5 mm wide beam") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "FDM"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Bridge span `{measured}` exceeds the recommended `{target}`. Unsupported strands will sag in the middle, leaving a rough underside that later layers cannot fully recover.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Bridge span `{measured}` exceeds the `{limit}` limit. Filament will droop and may detach from one anchor, leaving a failed region. Add a support pillar or redesign to shorten the gap.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Long span (`{measured}`): longer than the recommended `{target}` between supports. The middle may sag. Add a support or shorten the span.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Span too long (`{measured}`): past `{limit}`. It will likely fail to print. Add supports along it or reorient the part.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At most" value |
